artworks.title: a) Two Soldiers in a Trench (recto); b) Interior with Figures Seated Behind Table (verso)
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of two individuals in trenches. One person is shown from the chest up, leaning slightly forward with crossed arms. Their facial features are darkened with a beard. They wear a helmet and a coat. The second person is seated nearby, wearing a helmet, goggles, and a scarf covering most of their face. The background is shaded with crosshatching and lines, suggesting darkness. The trenches are lined with bag-like objects. A signature "frain" is in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: a) -Un farman?  -non, c'est un boche. (recto); b) Sketch of Figure (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) black crayon and brush and black ink on laid paper
b) black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a minimalistic style. The drawing depicts one figure resting against another, who appears to be supporting them. The figure providing support is sketched with attention to the clothing details and a helmet. The gazes and interactions between the figures suggest a poignant and emotional dynamic. The artwork is composed with light and confident strokes, capturing movement and posture with simplicity. The negative space adds to the emotional resonance. Handwritten text below the figures provides narrative context. The artist has signed the work.

artworks.title: Toward Justice
artworks.medium: black crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a series of sketchy lines and shapes creating an abstract scene. Two elongated, linear figures appear, with one figure sitting and the other standing, both resembling soldiers with helmet-like hats. The minimalistic and abstract nature of the drawing evokes rough charcoal sketches of uniformed figures at attention, with their simplified forms capturing a military-like presence. Behind them are abstract lines that may suggest distant landscapes or structures but lack detail. The overall composition uses sweeping and curved lines typical of abstract representation, with familiar connections evoking images of soldiers in the field.

artworks.title: Lost Illusions
artworks.medium: black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two figures. The figure on the left is depicted standing with a slightly slouched posture and is shown from the head to just below the waist. They have a mustachioed face with a blank expression, wearing a cap, collared coat, and gloves. The figure on the right is shown in a crouched posture with dynamic lines suggesting movement. They are depicted in a full-body view with a helmet and uniform-like clothing, and short hair. The scene has minimal detail, with faint background elements indicating a sparse environment. The background is primarily blank, with simple lines hinting at a trench-like setting.

artworks.title: The Economic Withdrawal
artworks.medium: black crayon and brush and black ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in sketch form. The drawing is done in a loose, expressive style using what appears to be charcoal or a similar medium on paper. The seated figure is positioned on a block or seat, with a relaxed posture and their face slightly turned. The standing figure has an outline that suggests they are holding or handling rope or similar objects, as indicated by the looping lines at their feet. The lines are bold and confident, capturing the essence of movement and form with minimal detail. The entire composition conveys a sense of casual interaction or conversation between two individuals, with an emphasis on gesture and posture.

artworks.title: Toward Peace
artworks.medium: brush with black and brown ink and black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three standing figures amidst rubble. The composition includes a classical statue-like figure in flowing robes facing two figures in military or official uniforms. The environment suggests a war-torn or ruined setting with scattered debris and vague outlines of a landscape or cityscape in the background. Bold and expressive lines are used, conveying a sense of tension or confrontation between the figures.

artworks.title: Hiding the "louis"
artworks.medium: brush and black ink and black crayon on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two illustrated figures. On the left, a person in a long coat, boots, and a helmet stands facing rightward with arms slightly extended and palms open. They have a sword on their left side. On the right, another person wears a long dress-like garment and a distinctive hat, leaning against a structure. The background suggests rough terrain with bags labeled "ROUM" nearby.

artworks.title: The Objective of War
artworks.medium: crayon and brush and gray ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling and leaning slightly forward, with their head tilted downward. They have short hair and wear a loose-fitting coat or cloak. The background appears to be a flat, expansive landscape with minimalistic linework and a few small figures in the distance to the right of the person's head.

artworks.title: a) Le Poilu et Prisonnier (Poilu and Prisoner) (recto); b) Study of Prisoner (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) watercolor and black crayon on wove paper
b) black crayon on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. The first figure on the left is standing with their head bowed and hands clasped in front of their chest. They have a bald head and are wearing a sleeveless undershirt with overalls. A shovel is leaning against a blue wheelbarrow beside them. The second figure is seated or kneeling, with their upper body facing the standing figure. This person is wearing a hat and a quilted garment. The background consists of abstract shapes with brush-like textures in ochre and grey tones, suggesting a distant landscape with structures. The scene is set against a plain light backdrop.

artworks.title: Voilà le Moment de le chantes tun "Wacht am Rhein"
artworks.medium: collotype on wove Arches paper
artworks.description: The illustration shows two figures standing side by side. One is a soldier and the other is a woman. The soldier is holding the woman's arm as they both look down at another soldier who is partially submerged in water. The submerged soldier's expression appears intense, with a furrowed brow and open mouth. The background is minimal with sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: Le Front de Vincennes
artworks.medium: collotype on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a half-body view. One person leans forward, supporting a large cylindrical object against their shoulder, while the other stands with their hands behind their back, facing the first person. Both individuals wear hats, uniform-like clothing, and boots. Their facial features are outlined, and details are obscured. No visible jewelry or accessories are seen. The background features a sketched landscape with more cylindrical objects in the distance and on the ground. Text at the top reads "LE FRONT DE VINCENNES," and cursive writing appears at the bottom.

artworks.title: Versailles, 28 Juin
artworks.medium: collotype on wove Arches paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person standing with their hands on a book on a table. The person seems to be speaking or addressing a group. They have a bald head, a mustache, and a serious expression, wearing a dark-colored garment. On the table in front of them is a helmet with a spike. In the background, there is a crowd of people. The setting appears formal, possibly a public event. The image includes the text "Versailles, 28 Juin."

artworks.title: Pour l'homme de demain
artworks.medium: collotype on Arches laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two figures. In the forefront, a woman is standing, hugging a young boy. The woman has her head slightly bowed and wears a headscarf or hood. The boy wears shorts and shoes. Behind them, there is a subtle sketch of another person crouched beside a large bundle. The background consists of an open landscape with swirling lines that suggest smoke or clouds extending into the sky.

artworks.title: Les Nuits de Paris
artworks.medium: collotype on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch-style scene with three people. One woman holds a baby, wearing a long dress and a scarf. Another person lies partially hidden in shadows, and a third figure is in profile leaning forward. The setting is indoors with furniture in the foreground and a textured backdrop. The image is rendered in monochrome.

artworks.title: La Defaillance Russe
artworks.medium: collotype on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two stylized figures embracing each other. The drawing depicts two figures in military attire, tightly locked in an embrace. The figures are positioned in the center of the scene, set on a battlefield with trenches filled with helmets and caps in the background. The style is sketch-like with bold, expressive lines. Below the figures, the words "LA 'DÉFAILLANCE' RUSSE" are inscribed. The drawing uses monochromatic shades.

artworks.title: A la Conference de la Paix
artworks.medium: collotype on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals depicted in a sketch style. The first person is standing, with hands resting on their knees. They have short, dark hair, a head covering, and wear a dark robe. The second person is seated on a bench, wearing a light-colored cloak and a helmet. The background is minimalistic, with a blank wall and a partial door outline. Beside the seated person is a table with various items.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in blue and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious gathering. The image shows a congregation of figures looking upwards towards a central chalice and a shining circle. Luminous rays radiate outward from the chalice. To the right of the chalice, a faint image of a cloaked figure stands. Surrounding the scene, text indicates the event is the "25ème Congrès Eucharistique International" held in Lourdes in 1914 from July 22nd to 26th. The style is reminiscent of early 20th-century poster art with graphic lines and a limited color palette focusing on black and blue hues.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in blue and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image features a semicircular shape in the top half filled with radiating lines converging towards a central point with a suspended chalice. Below, there are vaguely defined, cloaked figures seated or kneeling, resembling a congregation. Among them, the curved lines of shepherd-like staffs are visible. A ghostly figure in the upper right section bears a likeness to a religious apparition.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in green and black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering beneath a dome. The image shows a crowd of hooded and robed figures holding shepherd's crooks and facing a glowing chalice in the sky, with a bright light shining above it. The chalice is the central focus, with lines of light extending from it. A robed figure is faintly visible within the dome surrounding the crowd. The drawing conveys a sense of reverence and communal focus on the mysterious event.

artworks.title: Lourdes, 1914,  25th International Eucharistic Congress
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering focused on a luminous chalice under a dome. The scene depicts a large assembly of cloaked figures, whose heads are mostly bowed. At the center of their focus is a bright chalice suspended above the crowd, with beams of light emanating from it. To one side of the dome above, a figure in ethereal robes appears to be hovering. The use of shading and lines indicates a soft illumination, creating a serene atmosphere. The markings around the dome suggest architectural structures or spiritual rays, reinforcing the central theme of veneration.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in red and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a woman in a dynamic pose holding a mirror and an artist's brush. She is nude, with loose, wavy hair flowing back from her face. The background is a plain, light beige. The paper edges are visible.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person striking a dynamic pose while performing a high kick. They are positioned with one leg extended forward and the other slightly bent, their body leaning back slightly. The person has medium-length brown hair styled in a loose, windswept manner. They are dressed in a short, flowing dress or slip and wearing high-heeled shoes. In one hand, they are holding a closed umbrella. The background is a plain, light beige color, and above the person, there is a top hat, monocle, and chain.

artworks.title: First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched figure of a person dancing in a dynamic pose with one leg kicked high into the air. The figure is balanced on their left leg while holding an umbrella in their left hand. The person appears to have long hair flowing backward. They are wearing a dress and high-heeled shoes, emphasizing movement. A top hat and monocle are illustrated in the background.

artworks.title: "1er Salon des Humoristes, Palais des Modes (First Exhibition of the Humorists, Palace of Style)
artworks.medium: lithograph [poster] in black and red on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a woman in motion with a top hat in the air. The artwork is a poster for the "1er Salon de la Société des Dessinateurs Humoristes." The poster features a drawing of a woman in mid-kick, partially dressed, with an arm extending behind her holding an umbrella. The top hat appears to be flying off. The text is in French, indicating the event's date and location. The use of simple lines and a limited color palette focuses the attention on the written information and the action depicted.
